name: empiricompany/maho-ignition
description: Error pages and diagnostics integration for Maho Commerce using Spatie Ignition.

suggest.openai-php/client: OpenAI API client for Ignition's OpenAI solution provider.

scripts.cs: if [ -x vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer ]; then vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --config=.php-cs-fixer.php --dry-run --diff; else ../../vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --config=.php-cs-fixer.php --dry-run --diff; fi
scripts.rector: if [ -x vendor/bin/rector ]; then vendor/bin/rector --config=.rector.php --dry-run; else ../../vendor/bin/rector --config=.rector.php --dry-run; fi
